Based on the two listings, **neither seller is better — they are identical in every substantive detail**:

|  | **Ottervale Audio (A)** | **Brackmoor Sound (B)** |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Shipping | In stock, free, 3–5 business days | In stock, free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Product/specs | Stillwave H2, graphite, 40-hr battery, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3, same box contents | Same |

The **only difference is the seller name itself**. The listings provide no seller-specific advantage — price, delivery, return terms, or warranty — that would justify choosing one over the other.

So you can buy from either with the same expected outcome. If you want a tie-breaker, you'd need information not in these listings, such as independent reviews of Ottervale Audio vs. Brackmoor Sound's customer service.
